pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a clear single design (escape LIKE wildcards). The PR's claims match the diff.
No spec file in this change.

The new tests cover %, _, a mixed query and a backslash. Each would fail against the old unescaped LIKE. npm test could not run here because vitest is not installed, so I judged the tests by reading them.
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. No docs changed.
The escape regex covers \, % and _. ESCAPE '\\' in the JS string yields SQL ESCAPE '\'. The bind stays parameterized.
The query is still bound as a parameter, so there is no injection. The escaping removes unintended wildcard matching.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The behaviour-change, test and no-deleted-tests claims match the diff.
